rationale: Flow range is an engineering parameter independent of biology. Frozen based on CSF production rate and shunt drainage requirements.

total_drainage_rate_ml_min.rationale: Matches adult CSF production rate. Sufficient to maintain ICP homeostasis.

flow_per_segment_ml_min.rationale: If enzyme membrane spans 4-6 parallel channels, each handles 0.05-0.20 mL/min.

pulsation_amplitude_fraction.rationale: Cardiac-driven CSF pulsation amplitude (literature: 30-50% of mean flow).

pulsation_frequency_hz.rationale: Heart rate range 30-120 bpm. CSF pulsation tracks cardiac cycle.

minimum_flow_to_prevent_stasis_ml_min.rationale: Below this, CSF stasis promotes protein aggregation and biofilm. Drainage floor — see item 07.

constitutional_basis: Article XXVII — these thresholds have explicit provenance (CSF production literature) and explicit class (PHYSIOLOGICAL).
can_be_relaxed_only_by: Documented design change with rationale. Any change requires version bump (1.x → 2.x).
